translations.web: But a messenger came to Saul, saying, “Hurry and come; for the Philistines have made a raid on the land!”
translations.bsb: Then a messenger came to Saul, saying, “Come quickly, for the Philistines have raided the land!”
translations.kjv: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.
